items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: Clester Wells, John Mitchell, reeds; Wilbert Barranco, piano; William Dirvin, guitar; Julius Harris, bass, and Red Saunders, drums. Were all those people from Los Angeles?

ctx.x: And from '33 to '34, "Mosby fronted the band for the show 'Change Your Luck' which went on... an extensive Midwestern tour." He had Leroy Huston, Gene Prince, Theodore "Wingy" Carpenter on trumpet, Baron Willie Moorehead, trombone; William Johnson, Clester Wells, John Mitchell, reeds; Wilbert Barranco, piano; William Dirvin, guitar; Julius Harris, bass, and Red Saunders, drums. Were all those people from Los Angeles?
I don't remember a lot of those people. What year was that? '34?
